correctness.rationale: The affine-barycentric proof works for every n>=4, m=n+1, 0<=epsilon<1/m, and every proper nonempty k-subset A. Group permutation symmetry fixes the centroid of K_epsilon and each H_A section at lambda_i=1/m, and complementing A yields precisely 2^n-1 distinct hyperplanes. Each homothetic vertex cap has relative volume epsilon^n and stays entirely off each selected section, giving the exact halfspace-tail correction (Beta(k,l) upper tail minus k epsilon^n)/(1-m epsilon^n). Differentiating the moving Beta(k,l) threshold using independent within-block Dirichlet moments yields D^2F=f_beta(k/m)/[(1-m epsilon^n)m^2]*(sum_{A^c}v_j^2/[k(l+1)]-sum_A v_i^2/[l(k+1)]) on the within-block zero-sum tangent, Morse index k-1, coindex l-1, no tangent nullity. Independent Legendre quadrature for k=2,l=3 gave -0.01535999955 and +0.01727999959 against exact -0.01536 and +0.01728; finite n tests only corroborate the analytic all-n proof.
residual_risks: n>=4, 0<=epsilon<1/(n+1) only; no completeness for centroidal cuts.
